text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant told a news conference on Wednesday his government would seek close relations with the European Union, continue talks started under the previous government which would achieve a closer relationship but not full membership for Malta.
- Malta withdraws from Partnership for Peace as Switzerland joins. Opposition Nationalist Party says the withdrawal decision will harm Malta's international image.
- Farsons makes half year profit of Lm 158,000.
